definition: Five major demon groups analyzed through a startup lens: the CEO/CTO/CMO troika, business model, revenue, headcount, funding rounds, IPO status, and risk factors

monster_companies.CEO: Great Roc (third brother · de facto operator · Vulture Peak background)
monster_companies.CTO: Green Lion Spirit (eldest brother · steed of Manjusri Bodhisattva)
monster_companies.CMO: White Elephant Spirit (second brother · steed of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva)
monster_companies.business_model: Regional monopoly: an 800-li forbidden zone at Lion Camel Ridge; man-eating + tolls; clear division of labor among the three demons
monster_companies.revenue: Annual revenue of ~96,000 human lives (500-year cumulative) + strategic supplies
monster_companies.employees: 48,000 minor demons + 10,000 clerical/support staff; total roster ~58,000
monster_companies.funding_rounds: Angel round (Vulture Peak backing) → Series A (Manjusri endorsement) → Series B (Samantabhadra endorsement) → strategic investment (direct Tathāgata investment)
monster_companies.ipo_status: Pre-IPO stage; absorbed directly by Tathāgata; acquired before listing
risk_factors: CEO Great Roc is Tathāgata's uncle; extreme political risk; unpredictable regulation
Business model (man-eating) violates Heavenly law; compliance risk
All three founders have 'immortal/Buddhist backgrounds'; independence questionable
The Lion Camel Kingdom has already been destroyed; local market saturated
monster_companies.exit_outcome: Acquired directly by Tathāgata Buddha; the three demons returned to their owners; CEO Great Roc became Tathāgata's Dharma protector

monster_companies.CTO: Seventh Spider Sister (core silk-spinning tech; supported by the Centipede Spirit of Yellow Flower Temple)
monster_companies.CMO: Third Spider Sister (bathing-spring marketing; seduction-based conversion)
monster_companies.business_model: C2C platform; division of labor among seven sisters; Zhuogou Spring spa + seduction robbery; precise targeting of male customers
monster_companies.revenue: ~200 merchants robbed annually; cumulative wealth of 1,000+ taels of silver
monster_companies.employees: 7 sworn daughters (founding team) + 7 sworn sons (Centipede Spirit's team) + 50 minor demons
monster_companies.funding_rounds: Self-funded from the start; no external financing; strategic alliance with the Centipede Spirit
monster_companies.ipo_status: Never listed; wiped out by Wukong's team; entire executive team killed
risk_factors: Illegal business model; endangers personal safety
Small team; weak risk resilience
Reliance on the Zhuogou Spring (once used by the Seven Fairies); property disputes
Unstable support from the Centipede Spirit
monster_companies.exit_outcome: Wiped out by Wukong + Old Mother of Mount Li; the 7 spider spirits killed; the Centipede Spirit taken by Pilanpo Bodhisattva

monster_companies.CTO: No clear technical partner; self-developed earth-tunneling + the Bottomless Mountain maze
monster_companies.CMO: None; PR effect via kidnapping Tang Sanzang + forced marriage
monster_companies.business_model: Kidnapping-style SaaS; forced marriage + abduction; acquiring the scarce 'Tang Sanzang flesh' resource
monster_companies.revenue: No revenue; pure strategic investment; goal of attaining immortality
monster_companies.employees: 200+ minor demons; defense-in-depth at the Bottomless Cave of Trap-Earth Mountain
monster_companies.funding_rounds: Angel round (status as the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King's adopted daughter); no follow-on financing
monster_companies.ipo_status: Never listed; acquired directly by the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King + Nezha
risk_factors: CEO is the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King's adopted daughter; identity fraud (already claimed kinship)
Single business model; over-reliance on 'Tang Sanzang flesh'
The Bottomless Cave's deep defenses were ultimately breached
No independent technical partner; insufficient innovation
monster_companies.exit_outcome: Claimed and retrieved by the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King + Nezha; CEO taken back to Heaven for disposition

monster_companies.CEO: Bull Demon King (family business; Great Sage Pacifying Heaven)
monster_companies.CTO: Princess Iron Fan (palm-leaf fan tech monopoly; core cooling + firefighting tech)
monster_companies.CMO: Red Boy (Boy Sage King; Samadhi Fire; independent operation + brand building)
monster_companies.business_model: Scarce-resource monopoly: palm-leaf fan firefighting service; tolls + firefighting fees
monster_companies.revenue: 100+ firefighting engagements per year; 10 years of offerings each; extremely strong cumulative cash flow
monster_companies.employees: Family business; Bull Demon King + Princess Iron Fan + Red Boy + Jade-Faced Fox (concubine) + 500+ minor demons in various caves
monster_companies.funding_rounds: Self-funded from the start; no external financing; relies on family resources
monster_companies.ipo_status: Pre-IPO stage; the family business acquired by multiple parties; CEO Bull Demon King surrounded and absorbed by the gods
risk_factors: CEO Bull Demon King's bigamy (Princess Iron Fan + Jade-Faced Fox); chaotic governance
CMO Red Boy operated independently; absorbed after conflict with Guanyin Bodhisattva
Core tech (palm-leaf fan) depends on a single resource; not replicable
Serious family-business succession issues; marital separation caused strategic division
monster_companies.exit_outcome: The family fell apart; Red Boy absorbed by Guanyin; Bull Demon King surrounded and converted to Buddhism; Princess Iron Fan attained the right fruit

monster_companies.CTO: Self-developed; no technical partner; gained the 'light-blocking' ability through self-cultivation
monster_companies.CMO: None; topic marketing via stealing the cassock; accidental publicity
monster_companies.business_model: Knowledge-payment model; self-taught Buddhism + Daoism; traffic via the 'Buddha Robe Fair' brand event
monster_companies.revenue: No revenue; purely academic organization; sustained by alms
monster_companies.employees: Black Bear Spirit + Snake Spirit (CFO) + Gray Wolf Spirit (operations) + 30+ minor demons
monster_companies.funding_rounds: Self-funded from the start; later absorbed via strategic investment by Guanyin Bodhisattva
monster_companies.ipo_status: Never listed; acquired directly by Guanyin Bodhisattva; CEO transferred to Mountain Guardian
risk_factors: Small team; weak risk resilience
Unclear business model; no defined revenue
Stealing the cassock drew regulatory attention; risky event
No external financing; fragile capital chain
monster_companies.exit_outcome: Absorbed by Guanyin Bodhisattva; CEO Black Bear Spirit transferred to Mountain Guardian of Mount Luojia; a successful 'acquisition'

ipo_matrix.ipo_failure_root_cause: 100% of demon groups were acquired by upstream forces (Buddhism / Heaven); none had an independent IPO
ipo_matrix.key_pattern: Demon groups in Journey to the West are essentially 'already-acquired subsidiaries': seemingly independent but actually dependent

monster_business_insights: 100% of the five demon groups were acquired; none had an independent IPO, revealing the dependent nature of the 'demon economy' in Journey to the West
CEO background determines the exit path: those with Buddhist/immortal backing (the three Lion Camel demons) kept their lives; those without (Pansi Cave) were wiped out
The technical partner (CTO) determines viability: the three Lion Camel demons had complete tech; Pansi Cave had a single tech
Business model determines value: Flaming Mountain's scarce resource (the palm-leaf fan) earned the highest valuation; Black Wind Mountain relied on a knowledge premium
Chaotic governance split the family business (Flaming Mountain); the professionalized team (Lion Camel Ridge) was more efficient
The demon groups' 'risk factors' are all essentially compliance problems; the business model (man-eating / robbery) violates Heavenly law
The root cause of demon IPO failure: the regulator (Heaven + Vulture Peak) is both competitor and acquirer
